no_teams_listener_so_connection_rows_are.evidence: config/daemon-intent.ts:142-150 gives ControlDaemonIntent a webui but no listen: ListenIntent; :723 allows only ['version','daemon','webui','relations','admissions','discovery','peers'] for a control daemon, so [listen] is refused. runtime/control-process.ts:586 creates an empty ledger that is only read at :624 and passed at :647 and never written, so projectTeamsMembership reports a directory-known remote with no channel as state: 'disconnected' (network/teams-membership.ts:133-137).
